page: Microsoft Azure D8pds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on 64-bit ARM architecture running under Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 8 dedicated ARM vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance does not feature discrete GPU accelerators.

Storage capability includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD space alongside support for Premium Storage. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The ARM-based compute configuration provides resource density and energy-efficient processing, offering qualitative cost efficiency for environments running ARM-native binaries and multithreaded workloads that benefit from dedicated core allocations without x86 overhead.

The hardware configuration is suitable for balanced production environments, including web application serving, containerized services, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and database or cache workloads that utilize fast local NVMe storage for temporary data processing or scratch space.
